episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: In the series pilot, Max finds her hunt for fellow escapees aided by a techno-geek with a key to her past as a genetics experiment.

episodes.title: Heat
episodes.summary: Lydecker closes in after Max is reunited with the woman who saved her the night she escaped from the Manticore lab. Meanwhile, strange changes in Max's DNA have her crawling the walls.

episodes.title: Flushed
episodes.summary: Max goes above the law to secure meds for her worsening seizures and winds up behind bars---and at the mercy of a warped warden with a link to Lydecker. But as Logan and Original Cindy race to the rescue, Max finds a kindred spirit whose abusive past helps her face down a former demon.

episodes.title: C.R.E.A.M.
episodes.summary: Logan runs smack into his past while helping a client investigate her dad's mysterious death; Max helps Sketchy one-up a two-faced casino owner who bilked him for a bundle of cash.

episodes.title: 411 on the DL
episodes.summary: A lead on a fellow Manticore fugitive sends Max on a mission to find an old friend; Logan's ex returns, hoping to make amends for past sins; Herbal gets himself canned from the Jam Pony.

episodes.title: Prodigy
episodes.summary: Logan puts his life on the line to barter for Max's after a hostage crisis at a genetics conference traps Max with a deadly fellow attendee...Lydecker. But as the situation intensifies, it becomes clear that hunter and prey will have to play nice together to get out alive.

episodes.title: Cold Comfort
episodes.summary: Logan helps Zack and Max track down Lydecker after they tie him to the kidnapping of one of their fellow bio-synths. But when they get their former master where they want him, Lydecker fills the kids in on who was really behind the abduction...and why. Meanwhile, Cindy and Sketchy derail Normal's plan to impress a potential foreign investor.

episodes.title: Blah Blah Woof Woof
episodes.summary: Lydecker's manhunt for Vogelsang's killer puts Max on too many "most wanted" lists. Meanwhile, a stray bullet lodged in Logan's spine leaves him near death, forcing his protégée to make a decision that could save his life, but end her own.

episodes.title: Out
episodes.summary: Max and Logan's growing attraction is put to the test as he breaks their first date to bust a flesh-peddler, who makes it his sole mission to silence "For Eyes Only" forever. Meanwhile, the Jam Pony kids catch on to Normal's new lady after he sends a delivery to her domicile.

episodes.title: Red
episodes.summary: Logan recruits Max to guard a Federal witness who can nail Mayor Steckler, only to find that the man in need of protection is a face from their not-so-distant---and very painful---pasts. But keeping the guy safe proves deadly as a corps of superhuman soldiers steps in to take care of Steckler's business.

episodes.title: Art Attack
episodes.summary: Max is Logan's date for a Cale family wedding, where the wisecracking crime fighter gets in touch with her softer side, and Logan gets in deep with a lady he used to love. But the big day is dashed for Max after Normal is abducted by an angry art forger who has deadly plans for the man unless someone shows up with his precious pilfered painting.

episodes.title: Rising
episodes.summary: The Red supersoldiers kidnap Original Cindy (Valarie Rae Miller) to get to Max, whose overamped DNA may be the key to their survival---and Logan's chance to walk again. Meanwhile, it seems like some of Max's best buds are starting to change, and not necessarily for the better.

episodes.title: The Kidz Are Aiight
episodes.summary: It's a race to save the Manticore fugitives after Zack escapes from Lydecker's lair and enlists Max to help round up their lost friends. Meanwhile, Max finds herself growing even closer to a newly mobile Logan; and Original Cindy gets herself a new place to live now that her old landlord is dead.

episodes.title: Female Trouble
episodes.summary: Max battles her conscience after catching a fellow Manticore experiment hell-bent on killing a doctor with a tie to their past---and Max's future with Logan. But when Lydecker puts them all in the line of fire, Max is forced to choose between an old friend and her new flame.

episodes.title: Haven
episodes.summary: A weekend away in a sleepy---and creepy---little town has Max helping a boy who sees dead people and Logan investigating the murders of several political activists.

episodes.title: Shorties in Love
episodes.summary: Max's plan to steal a set of computer discs is derailed by Original Cindy's felonious ex-lover, who draws the unwanted attention of a shadowy pharmaceutical firm. But once they catch her, it may be too late for Max to save the comely con artist from triggering the end of the world without even knowing it.

episodes.title: Pollo Loco
episodes.summary: When two corpses turn up with the bar code of an escaped X-5, Lydecker's boss steps in to pay him an unexpected---and unpleasant---visit. Meanwhile, Max springs into action after realizing that her fellow fugitive may be behind the killings and that she is the only one who can bring his hunting season to a close.

episodes.title: I and I Am a Camera
episodes.summary: Max gets herself a sidekick after a pseudo-superhero calling himself the Street Sweeper strong-arms his way into a hunt for the person offing recently paroled felons. But when Logan uncovers his uncle's tie to the crimes, he fears the Cale family fortune could be nothing but blood money and must decide whom to trust. And whom to turn against.

episodes.title: Hit a Sista Back
episodes.summary: It's a battle of the bio-synths as Max, Zack and Tinga's plan to stop Lydecker from snagging Tinga's son pits them against Madame X's newest weapon---a brainwashed Brin. But when a double-cross puts them all in danger, it becomes clear that someone at Manticore is keeping secrets about the future of the X-5 project.

episodes.title: Meow
episodes.summary: On the anniversary of their meeting, Max's cat DNA sends her into heat, forcing her to bail on a date with Logan. Meanwhile, Lydecker and X play a game of cat and mouse with Max that puts her in harm's way and Manticore's top agent on his own boss's hit list.

episodes.title: ...And Jesus Brought a Casserole
episodes.summary: Madame X's twisted plan for Max forces Lydecker into an unholy pact with a pack of his former "kids" to bring down Manticore. But when things go tragically awry, Logan must make a life-altering choice that could put Max back into the hands of the enemy.

episodes.title: Designate This
episodes.summary: A rebuilt Max maps her escape from Madame X's lair, as Logan finds an unlikely ally in exposing Manticore and its genetic experiments. But when Max is forced to do her captor's dirty work, it begins to look like Eyes Only's days are over.

episodes.title: Bag 'Em
episodes.summary: Max takes several child transgens under her wing after they become targets of White's lethal "cleanup" project to bury Manticore's existence.

episodes.title: Proof of Purchase
episodes.summary: Alec hides his deadly reason for helping Max stop a rampaging Joshua, whose pattern of attacks could lead them right to Sandeman. Meanwhile, Lydecker makes a startling find while digging into Renfro's botched experiments at a demolition site.

episodes.title: Radar Love
episodes.summary: As a mysterious virus targets Seattle's Asian community, Max and Logan find themselves facing a new foe---and possible new lovers. Meanwhile, the search for Joshua's creator hits a dead end.

episodes.title: Boo
episodes.summary: Max tracks a deadly---and decapitated---Manticore nomlie as Halloween proves a prime time for the mutants to roam Seattle undetected. But as she and Joshua close in on the headless assassin, she almost loses her own head when it becomes clear that Logan and Asha have been spending a bit too much time together.

episodes.title: Two
episodes.summary: The hunt is on for Joshua after three Seattle cops are attacked by a canine-like killer; Alec snags a job at Jam Pony as a way to score the money he owes Max.

episodes.title: Some Assembly Required
episodes.summary: Logan's hunt for a gang of Steelheads reveals a shocking truth about Max's presumed-dead cohort and his ominous mission to make Cale pay for the botched Manticore attack. But when Max sees that her friend has gone commando, she's forced to choose between "family" and her feelings for Logan. Meanwhile, Original Cindy finds the perfect way to keep Normal off Max's back for missing work while she tends to her dangerous duties.

episodes.title: Gill Girl
episodes.summary: Max and Alec race to save a mermaid from White's clutches after realizing she may be linked to Manticore's fishy genetics project. Meanwhile, Logan has a brush with death after he and Max get a little too close while babysitting his niece.

episodes.title: Medium is the Message
episodes.summary: A mother in mourning hires Logan to find her missing son, who may have a shocking tie to White...and a woman Logan knows very well. Meanwhile, Alec taps into Joshua's secret skills to make a killing in the art market, but ends up putting Max's medical research in peril after her papers become part of the dog-boy's paintings.

episodes.title: Brainiac
episodes.summary: Max gets some help from Manticore's plus-sized secret---and smitten---weapon after a mole sets a trap to silence Asha's rebel group.

episodes.title: The Berrisford Agenda
episodes.summary: Alec tries to right a wrong from his past after he realizes the former lover he was forced to assassinate may still be alive.

episodes.title: Borrowed Time
episodes.summary: Max and Logan make a run for romance after an antidote sends her virus into a 12-hour remission. But their hopes for a night of heat are cooled after Joshua crashes their reunion to report that a Manticore mutant is on the loose.

episodes.title: Harbor Lights
episodes.summary: A stray bullet sends Max to the ER, where her funky blood and DNA tests cause grave concern for the CDC---and Ames White's army. But as Logan races to get his girl to safety, a new threat emerges that could thrust Max into a governmental nightmare.

episodes.title: Love in Vein
episodes.summary: Max takes on a cult of superhuman blood addicts led by a Manticore mutant intent on rebuilding an X-5 army. Meanwhile, Joshua falls in with the wrong crowd after Alec dupes him into delivering his packages at Jam Pony.

episodes.title: Fuhgeddaboudit
episodes.summary: A telekinetic transgenic messes with Max's mind to keep her from coercing a meek mob bookie into selling out his boss to Eyes Only. But once the mutant sets her sights on Alec, the stakes are raised, leading him back into the boxing ring to make some money for some not-so-good fellas.

episodes.title: Exposure
episodes.summary: Max and Logan track Ames' kidnapped son to a small town where the breeding cult is readying Manticore's youngest creations for a mysterious ceremony. Meanwhile, Alec and Original Cindy take it upon themselves to stop Sketchy from uncovering the truth about the transgens running amok.

episodes.title: Hello, Goodbye
episodes.summary: After nearly infecting Logan, Max decides to end their affair for good; Alec's haunted by the sins of his Manticore twin; and White triggers a witch hunt by leaking info about the transgens to the media. Meanwhile, Joshua finds the perfect woman, but can't find the courage to confess his secret.

episodes.title: Dawg Day Afternoon
episodes.summary: Max must break her vow to avoid Logan after Joshua becomes a target of a transgenic manhunt in the sewers; White leaks news of the human-looking X-5s to the media, leading to a wide-scale attack against the so-called "monsters" running amok.

episodes.title: She Ain't Heavy
episodes.summary: Max's escape from Seattle is derailed after White sends in her clone to capture the elusive X-452; Logan's Eyes Only compound is attacked; Joshua finds a new home among his fellow mutants; and White takes the stand with a revelation sure to turn the entire nation against the transgens.

episodes.title: Love Among the Runes
episodes.summary: A bogus transgen lures Max into White's trap, where she learns the truth about the mystery marks appearing on her skin; the Terminal City dwellers mount a campaign to battle the humans hunting them down; Alec learns why Logan has been keeping his distance from his former friends.

episodes.title: Freak Nation
episodes.summary: The hunt for mutants leads to a hostage crisis at Jam Pony, where Max and company face not only violent vigilantes, but also White's killer corps of mutant hunters.
